item.description: Atlanta Public Schools AVTF teachers visited The Atlanta Voice to discuss the importance of local journalism and how to work together to promote reading and media literacy among students. item.title: ‘Reverend Jackson was my superhero’: Jesse Jackson: 1941-2026
item.description: Civil rights activist and icon, Jesse Jackson, passed away at the age of 84, leaving behind a legacy of Black pride and excellence, as well as the Rainbow PUSH Coalition, which continues to advocate for voting rights, social programs, and civil rights. The post ‘Reverend Jackson was my superhero’: Jesse Jackson: 1941-2026 appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.title: ‘This race is not about party labels’: Duncan gets endorsed by former Georgia NAACP President Woodall
item.description: Former Georgia NAACP President James Woodall, Sr. has endorsed Geoff Duncan for Governor of Georgia, citing his ability to win in November and his commitment to strategy and courage. item.description: At the "When HIStory Was Watching" event, Ambassador Andrew Young, Atlanta Mayor Andre Dickens, and other legacy families, archivists, and civic leaders discussed the importance of preserving and protecting civil rights archives and the legacy of Ernest C. item.title: 9to5 Georgia leads ‘Advocacy Day’ for paid leave at State Capitol
item.description: 9to5 Georgia hosted an advocacy day at the Georgia State Capitol to support paid leave, emphasizing the need for comprehensive leave policies that cover all workers and urging legislators to fund an actuarial study to explore workable solutions. item.title: Abortion clinics are closing, even in states that have become key access points
item.description: The number of abortion clinics in the US has decreased since the Supreme Court Dobbs decision, with 753 brick-and-mortar clinics remaining as of 2025, 54 fewer than in 2020, and even states with protective abortion policies are struggling to provide access to care. The post Abortion clinics are closing, even in states that have become key access points appeared first on The Atlanta Voice.

item.description: Atlanta United players Steven Alzate and Juan Berrocal are looking forward to starting the season on the road in Cincinnati, with the team hoping to build on last year's performance and take advantage of a healthy back line and new signing Fafa Picault. item.description: Ruki's Kitchen, a pop-up turned food stall, is making waves in Atlanta's local food scene with its modern take on traditional Ethiopian cuisine, created by Chef Ali Lemma, who left his banking job to pursue his passion for cooking.
